languageDescription: Choose English or Bangla for buttons, menus, and other app text. Item names and notes stay as you entered them.
timezoneDescription: Event logs, discussions, and notifications display in this timezone. Calendar dates (due dates, planned work) stay as entered.
timeFormatDescription: Choose 24-hour clock or 12-hour with AM/PM for time pickers across the app.
productionMachinePicksDescription: When assigning a machine to a batch step, choose warn-only or block rules for off, maintenance, and schedule overlap.
pageGuidesDescription: First-visit walkthroughs on Orders and other pages. Reset to see them again.
savedStampDescription: Draw or upload a personal stamp to place on attachment markups.
